text.zh_CN:
你也应该意识到了吧？研究台虽然是解锁研究必要的东西，但是特别不方便。现代研究台可以让事情变得更简单。(或者单纯当个装饰也不是不行)
现在用法杖shift+右键研究台就可以让研究台"现代化"
而且现代研究台可以和某些方块进行联动...
text.en_US:
You may have noticed that the research table is essential, but rather inconvenient. A modern research desk makes things easier. (It also makes a fine decoration.)
Sneak and right-click a research table with a wand to modernize it.
The desk can also work with certain nearby blocks...
